experience.title: Business System Consultant
description: Leading multiple initiatives in a large IT ecosystem (~$12M annual budget) to facilitate and modernize ETL of payroll and personnel data to internal and external vended systems.
Introduced modern development practices to a mature enterprise team.

* Provided hands-on training and reference implementations of contemporary cloud technology (e.g. Infrastructure As Code pipelines in Azure DevOps, Function Apps) that remains the backbone of the team's development infrastructure to this day.
* Coached team on support methodology. Developed documentation that became the team's standard of quality.
* Mentored junior staff and helped them skill into their roles. Fostered an attitude of proactive engagement.

Spearheaded the team's first-ever serverless code project (using Azure Function Apps), which ingested data from a new partner (LPL) into payroll processor. This enabled the capability of selling products with the new partner, preventing a breach of contract and opening new markets via a proliferation of licensed sellers of our products.
Built a system to transfer employee data on an automated basis to BluB0X, a brand new security/badging system.
* Completed the project on time despite scope creep, allowing the opening of a brand new building to proceed without delay.

Coordinated knowledge transfer and task assignment for large-scale logistical projects. Managed projects to accelerate their completion timelines and create reference documentation for future endeavors.
Led multiple hackathon teams that produced viable proofs of concept and upskilled IT workers across the enterprise.
Proactively developed learning of domain knowledge when team responsibilities shifted.

* Our team is now responsible for administering the suite of batch processes that keep data about our represented agents' licensure in sync with RegEd, our vendor system. These programs are also responsible for disseminating updates about said information to various other teams throughout the company who need to be updated on which representatives are able to sell their policies. Our team's knowledge and documentation of these systems is sorely lacking, but I am filling the need by learning what needs to be known and helping the rest of the team figure it out too.
